correctness.rationale: For GP(10,2), independent exact induced-forest enumeration finds 755608 faces including empty, across 2^20 masks. The independently reconstructed vertex-toggle matching has 377742 pairs, with 34 critical 11-cells and 90 critical 12-cells; full 6967280-incidence Hasse topological sort is acyclic. Signed 34x90 Morse differential independently reconstructed from oriented simplex boundaries has precisely 125 nonzero entries, all +/-1, and unimodular elimination isolates 24 unit pivots and an identically zero residual, yielding Htilde_11=Z^10, Htilde_12=Z^66. Since the Morse CW complex has a single basepoint and cells only in dimensions 11 and 12, integer degree-vector cell cancellation establishes a genuine wedge of 10 S^11 and 66 S^12, not just homology. No general GP(n,2) claim follows.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The same vertex-induced-forest complex appears as the endpoint of the forest filtration, but the family theorems inspected in Carnero Bravo and Taylan concern paths, cycles, cactus graphs, joins and related graphs, rather than GP(10,2). Published dodecahedral ordinary independence, matching and Rips results operate on different simplicial face predicates; without an explicit equivalence they do not cover the claimed mixed-dimensional integral wedge.

value.rationale: The dodecahedron is a canonical cubic, planar, vertex-transitive graph; induced forests directly concern feedback-vertex sets. Exact integral mixed-dimensional homotopy with nontrivial cancellation of 24 cell pairs is a natural finite invariant not reducible to Euler characteristic or previously tabulated ordinary independence homology.
